To make your document look
professionally produced, Word
provides header, footer, cover
page, and text box designs that
complement each other.
For example, you can add a
matching cover page, header, and
sidebar. Click Insert and then
choose the elements you want
from the different galleries.
Themes and styles also help keep
your document coordinated. When
you click Design and choose a
new Theme.
Save time in Word with new
buttons that show up where you
need them. To change the way a
picture fits in your document,
click it and a button for layout
options appears next to it.
When you work on a table, click
where you want to add a row or
a column, and then click the plus
sign.You can also type a keyword
to search online for the video
that best fits your document.
